chunks.title: After pickup
chunks.text: Returned items go through a quality check (QC) at the warehouse. The refund is initiated within 2 business days of pickup once the item passes QC. For ZentroMart Plus members, the refund is initiated at the time of pickup. Refund timelines after initiation are in the Refunds policy.

chunks.title: How long refunds take after initiation
chunks.text:
Refunds go back to the original payment method. Timelines are counted in business days from the day the refund is initiated.

| Payment method | Time to reach you |
| --- | --- |
| UPI | 1 to 3 business days |
| Credit or debit card | 5 to 7 business days |
| Net banking | 3 to 5 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet | Instant, within 2 hours |
| Bank transfer (NEFT) for cash-on-delivery orders | 5 to 7 business days |
| ZentroMart Wallet for cash-on-delivery orders | Instant, within 2 hours |

chunks.title: Benefits
chunks.text:
- Free Express delivery where Express is available.
- No reverse pickup fee on any return.
- Refunds on returns are initiated at pickup, without waiting for quality check.

ZentroMart Plus does **not** change return windows, return eligibility or refund timelines after initiation.
